method: All 48 linked function bodies and decorators inspected; semantic review with supplemental existing tests. No product pytest execution by R4. Baseline defects from other reviewers remain separate.

requirements.requirement: One repository has HTTPS, SSH and local locators; editing one leaves its UUID and earlier Core evidence byte-for-byte unchanged.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Real SHA-1/SHA-256 acquisition precedes adding HTTPS/SSH bindings and disabling each new profile. Exact preexisting Core-table snapshots and repository UUID are compared afterward. Saved remote protocols are representable; they are not remote executors.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No transport execution claim.

requirements.requirement: Same locator text in two scopes resolves independently; conflicting UUIDs for the same scoped locator are rejected without merging or overwriting either ID.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Initial bind replay returns duplicate; conflicting same-Scope bind raises BINDING_CONFLICT; identical text under S2 resolves to R2 while S1 stays R1.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No URL-based identity merge.

requirements.requirement: Multiple profiles are reusable across locators; profile rotation does not change locator keys, captures or Source memberships.
requirements.assertion_semantics: One profile is assigned to two repository locators, both receive distinct UUID plans, disabling that profile removes all grants. Separate stack test compares preexisting Core facts after profile edits.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Source membership preservation is architectural isolation evidence here: these fixtures have no Context membership to compare. Do not claim a dedicated membership-mutation assertion.

requirements.requirement: A preference for repository A cannot point to repository B's assignment; composite FK attacks and missing parents fail.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Preference for R2 against R1 assignment and missing profile assignment are rejected; only valid preference persists. Deliberately orphaned profile cannot vanish through a join: CORRUPT plus Access stop is asserted.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Direct SQL full-grant/FK attacks also exist elsewhere in this selected test module.

requirements.requirement: Scope Locators use maximum registration time; equal-time first choices remain ambiguous. No lexical/rowid/arrival tie-break or implicit cross-account fallback. Repository/profile preferences do not inherit this new timestamp rule.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Tied latest registration blocks default grant although the original remains approved; one-candidate bound yields CANDIDATE_LIMIT. A second repository/profile remains ambiguous even when only the first has a grant; saved explicit preference is honored.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Timestamp ranking applies to Scope registration only.

requirements.requirement: Git-only saved access works with no Context; Core-only offline use works with no Access. An imported domain catalog cannot start network work.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Nonseed local acquisition asserts actual retained metadata and Context absence. Removing or stopping Access leaves actual retained Core metadata readable. Context-only import/export preserves provider/membership and creates no Access.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No implicit saved Access store is opened during domain Exchange.

requirements.requirement: Different SSH aliases, scp-relative/URI-absolute paths, percent escapes, `.git`, trailing slashes, IPv6, symlinks, Windows drive/UNC and relative bases retain the declared semantics; unsupported inputs fail without changing files/credentials.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Linked exact URI tests concern Scope Locators. Repository negative grammar and finite executor rejection cover Windows/UNC/relative/helper/symlink exclusions. Existing positive repository grammar test is a useful additional link.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No exhaustive Repository-alias/escape/IPv6 matrix is claimed. Storage support and local execution support differ.

requirements.requirement: Malicious helper syntax, shell options, proxy URLs, embedded secrets and import activation attempts are rejected before external side effects; no secrets leak to saved plans, logging, manifests or domain Exchange.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Typed profile options reject secrets, unsafe commands and host/TLS overrides. Synthetic Access sentinel remains exact during Context export; raw diagnostics omit canary path. Correctly rechecksummed malicious imports are covered in item14.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Names/prose are not a DLP guarantee; sensitive nonsecret references remain Access configuration.

requirements.requirement: Disabling a Scope route retains all registration facts. Removing mutable repository/profile configuration does not delete Scope history, Source known-positive pairs, Core objects/captures or Context evidence.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Disable/reenable across Scope context, route, profile, binding and assignment removes old grant; original registration tuple survives. Real acquisition stack test compares Core facts after configuration edits.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No general configuration-removal API is implemented. Do not infer deletion management or a direct Source-membership comparison from these tests.

requirements.requirement: Concurrent configuration edits cannot combine one version's locator with another version's credentials; request plans, cancellation and retries are consistent and keep original observation identity and cumulative work.
requirements.independent_static_assessment: supported finite scope; subject to R2 findings
requirements.assertion_semantics: Two CAS writers produce exactly update and STALE_SETTINGS. Final handoff tests assert callback not invoked, descriptor closed and token consumed after expiry/revocation/latest/cancel. Retry route change must fail before subprocess launch.
requirements.limits_and_gates: This verifies bounded application checkpoints, not cross-process linearizability or instantaneous revocation of an already running command.

requirements.requirement: Additional repositories beyond the Core seed can acquire independently without weakening catalog pairing, UUID selection or cross-repository Exchange fences.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Nonseed native/Notes paired admission asserts target UUID, real captures, and unchanged physical seed/instance identity. Replaying native request under another repository is refused.
requirements.limits_and_gates: General GitMetadataInput and multi-repository Exchange remain seed-scoped at the fixed baseline. R3/root reproductions and correction are required; pairing/selection fences must survive.

requirements.requirement: An Access backup made with live WAL is coherent; interrupted/invalid restore is not activated. Continuity preserves Scope UUID/history, but another machine's local execution binding and approvals are not inherited.
requirements.assertion_semantics: A real WAL writer commits before the pinned backup and a second commit at the backup cut; copied rows include the first and exclude the second. Process exit before publication leaves no destination, source unchanged and unpromoted stage. Restored acquisition needs route enablement then approval.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Local approval and activation are distinct; Scope continuity preserves UUID/history.

requirements.requirement: Missing/isolated corrupt Access yields honest access errors; proven-sound domain reads still work; a real Core/Context stop is never bypassed.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Absent/stopped Access produces Access error while actual Core metadata remains exact/readable. A persistent Core stop rejects before Git and before measured work. Other registry tests corrupt persisted values to exercise diagnosed Access stop.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Isolated Access stop is not a Core integrity certificate. Broad storage doubt still invokes P7.

requirements.requirement: Context key classification preserves provider facts/observed URLs but rejects transport configuration in ordinary domain Exchange. Historical provenance is not silently redacted or advertised as free of location information.
requirements.independent_static_assessment: supported finite scope; subject to R3 findings
requirements.assertion_semantics: Malicious registration/envelope fields are rechecksummed and rejected for all four Context sections, even when Context is unselected, before a sentinel Core object is admitted. Descriptive URL candidates, membership and exact historical RepositoryClaim values survive Exchange.
requirements.limits_and_gates: SHA-256 is content consistency only; package replacement plus digest does not authenticate an issuer.

requirements.requirement: Real-data extraction is opt-in, leaves sources unchanged and reports excluded or unclassified legacy settings instead of guessing or executing them.
requirements.independent_static_assessment: outside current implementation; no real-data operation
requirements.assertion_semantics: No extractor is implemented or exercised. The routing ledger explicitly classifies keys and refuses to infer Scope/time/execution. There are no linked extraction tests.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Missing optional legacy extractor is distinct from unavailable real-data authorization. Unreleased/no-compatibility scope makes legacy migration no automatic prerequisite for Access acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Wheel/sdist behavior, schema/FK/immutability checks and P7 domain backup scope remain consistent at the exact integrated tree; ordinary file bodies remain excluded and ADR 0028 time/trust rules remain intact.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Ordinary blob acquisition is rejected with no retained metadata/Notes payload; physical schema includes exact packaged SQL, full triple key and FK checks; routing audit checks 25 override routes. Wheel/sdist smoke and full selected runtime are separate execution artifacts.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Independent review, ADR replacement approval, merge, P8 and release qualification are separate gates; none is an implementation requirement supplied by passing tests.

requirements.requirement: Same display name with different Scope UUIDs remains distinct; rename leaves FK/external references unchanged; a URI/URN is never a substitute identity.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Two UUIDs may share the same display label with no seed or Context. Renaming S1 preserves original registration and UUID; conflicting non-CAS label registration fails.
requirements.limits_and_gates: URI/URN rejection is tested by pure Scope locator validation.

requirements.requirement: A(T1), B(T2), A(T3) retains three rows; T3 wins; exact replay keeps row count/time.
requirements.assertion_semantics: A(T1), B(T2), A(T3) all insert, original A replay returns duplicate, complete descending history retains all three original coordinates and first choice is T3.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Same triple intentionally denotes one registration fact, not separate attempt events.

requirements.requirement: Same-time different URIs coexist; query returns both regardless of insertion order and regardless of only one being approved.
requirements.assertion_semantics: B then A at the same time both remain in first choices despite enabling only A; bounded limit errors rather than selecting one. Default grant remains ambiguous with the original grant present.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Competing two-handle ties exist elsewhere. Do not infer authentication from approval or URI order.

requirements.requirement: Clock rollback, late replay and restore never fabricate a fresh timestamp; unknown/invalid/bool/float/string/overflow input receives the reviewed diagnostic.
requirements.assertion_semantics: None/bool/zero/negative/float/string/overflow times are rejected before SQL. Earlier registration is retained with precedes_latest and original maximum; restore compares exact original three-row history and untouched input artifact.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No receiver/restore time manufactures registration freshness.

requirements.requirement: Newest unapproved/disabled/unsupported route blocks default execution; it never silently promotes an older approved route. Imported future times grant no trust.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Newer disabled route blocks, enabling it still needs approval, explicit older route remains deliberate, and A at a fresh time cannot borrow prior grant. Remote/container/symlink paths are explicitly refused by local executor.
requirements.limits_and_gates: No arbitrary future timestamp becomes an execution grant.

requirements.requirement: Changing Scope route/profile/binding invalidates affected reviewed plans; returning to the same URI at T3 cannot reuse approval for T1.
requirements.independent_static_assessment: supported finite scope; subject to R2 findings
requirements.assertion_semantics: Profile/context/repository-binding A-to-B-to-A removes all old grants; a new same-URI registration needs a new approval; final executor preparation changes cannot invoke callback using old permission.
requirements.limits_and_gates: SQL invalidation and runtime authority are separate layers.

requirements.requirement: A continuing Scope migration preserves UUID and old facts; an independent fork allocates new Scope UUID and does not relabel original S1 history as S2 history.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Fork preserves exact source history and source grants, creates only one new target registration/time, disables copied settings and preserves repository UUID. Trying original request under fork fails INCOMPATIBLE_REPLAY; genuinely new capture/request succeeds.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Independent clones receive a new Scope; old history is not relabeled.

requirements.requirement: Backup/restore round-trips every registration, not just MAX(time), with local reapproval; Core offline operations still work without Access.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Stack scenario compares restored Scope/history and actual Core facts, rejects before reapproval, and later increases original request work. Ties survive restore. Existing all-history backup/restore tests provide stronger explicit historical-prefix assertions.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Add full-history backup and continuation test links; the linked stack fixture alone has only one registration.

requirements.requirement: Generic UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE/mutating upserts and Scope-deletion cascades cannot erase or rewrite immutable registration coordinates on supported connections.
requirements.assertion_semantics: Direct UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE and parent Scope mutation are rejected with registration rows exact afterward. REPLACE remains rejected with recursive triggers disabled. Full key shape and no surrogate are separately inspected.
requirements.limits_and_gates: Supported connections deny generic mutation; privileged arbitrary DDL/file-owner tamper is outside this API capability contract.

requirements.requirement: Current request replay cannot silently switch routes after a newer registration; unchanged old intent and cumulative-work accounting remain intact.
requirements.independent_static_assessment: supported finite scope; subject to R2/R3 findings
requirements.assertion_semantics: Inactive restore plus reapproval resumes the same request without changing prior Core facts and with increased actual cost; a fork cannot retarget that request. Deleting/reinitializing Operational still yields CONTINUATION_UNAVAILABLE.
requirements.limits_and_gates: New latest route retry refusal before Git is an additional existing link; no silent new Capture or zero-cost restart.
